description: This script manages the download, extraction, installation, verification, and status update of software bundles in a device management system. It sources utility scripts, defines functions for each step, and processes a list of bundles for installation or update.

methods.name: downloadApp
methods.description: Downloads the application bundle from a remote location to a local directory.

methods.name: extractApp
methods.description: Extracts the downloaded bundle and performs sanity checks.

methods.name: installApp
methods.description: Installs the application by extracting package contents into the designated directory.

methods.name: searchApp
methods.description: Searches for an installed application in predefined directories.

methods.name: verifyAppSignature
methods.description: Verifies the application's signature using an external script.

methods.name: postVerifyInstall
methods.description: Executes post-installation scripts if specified in package metadata.

methods.name: updatePkgStatus
methods.description: Updates the package status broadcast with current installation state.

methods.name: updatePackage
methods.description: Coordinates the download, extraction, installation, verification, and post-install steps for a package.
